{'0': "A new leak has revealed that one of the Apple Watch's most popular watch faces, Modular, will get several new color customization options in watchOS 27. Here are the details."}

{'1': 'Modular watch face will get new color customization options in watchOS 27'}

{'2': 'Apple will expand the Modular watch face customization options in watchOS 27.'}

{'3': 'Modular has always been a top choice for many users due to its incredible flexibility. Not only does it offer ample room for complications, but users can also customize the look of the watch face with various color options.'}

{'4': 'Aaron Perris earlier discovered that iOS 27 beta 5 revealed nine new color options coming to Modular in watchOS 27.'}

{'5': 'This beta version does not yet include preview images of these nine new colors. However, Perris found the names of these colors in the beta code.'}

{'6': 'Some of these new colors may very well be previews of new bands for the Apple Watch Series 12 or Apple Watch Ultra 4 launching next month.'}

{'7': 'Additionally, Mark Gurman previously reported that Apple will launch a brand new Modular watch face in watchOS 27, inspired by the Modular Ultra.'}

{'8': 'Which watch faces do you use the most? Feel free to share with us in the comments section below.'}
